bio_excerpt: Gazzi is the alias of Pablo Jiménez, a producer and DJ from Linares, Jaén, now based in Madrid. His music mixes post-dubstep, UK bass, deep house and breakbeat. He released the Tus Ojos EP on Ano Ano in February 2025 and was on the Magnetic Fields 2023 lineup in India.

name: NATASHA DIGGS
bio_excerpt: Natasha Diggs is a New York City DJ and the resident of the Soul in the Horn party series. She plays soul, funk, hip-hop, disco and Latin records, mostly on vinyl. She was the official DJ on Lauryn Hill's 2015 international tour.
